description: This file defines the IMediaKeys interface and the IMediaKeysFactory class for Rialto's media decryption API, including method signatures for session management, key selection, and DRM store operations.

classes.name: IMediaKeysFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IMediaKeys instances.

classes.name: IMediaKeys
classes.description: Interface defining the public API for media key management and DRM operations.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates a new IMediaKeys instance for a specified key system.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for a key session (Netflix API).

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key session contains a specific key.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session and returns its ID.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request for a session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates a key session with license response data.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: deleteDrmStore
methods.description: Deletes the DRM store for the key system.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store for the key system.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves a hash of the DRM store.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves a hash of the key store.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Gets the limit on LDL key sessions.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code for a session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the internal CDM key session ID.
